item.title: Tasogare ni Hisomu Fukurou to, Akegata no Subaru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ENTERGRAM
  • 発売日: 2024-12-26
  • スコア: 5.93/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 黄昏に潜む梟と、明け方の昴
  • 英語名: Tasogare ni Hisomu Fukurou to, Akegata no Subaru

别名

  • Dawning Subaru

あらすじ

The story is set in winter, at Seibunka Private Academy in Asahikawa, Hokkaido. The protagonist, Subaru Sakaki, and his childhood friend, Honoka Takamura, are excited as the final Christmas party of their school life approaches. However, their joyful days are shattered by the sudden news that their classmate Miyabi Yashiro and homeroom teacher Asuka Yuri have been murdered. And their close friend Kazuha Shinozaki has been arrested as the murder suspect. Believing in their friend’s innocence, Subaru and Honoka begin their investigation to uncover the truth behind the incident, but behind the scenes, someone deeply connected to a “certain secret” of theirs is pulling the strings.

item.title: Seifuku Kanojo: Mayoigo Engage
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ENTERGRAM
  • 発売日: 2024-09-25
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 制服カノジョ まよいごエンゲージ
  • 英語名: Seifuku Kanojo: Mayoigo Engage

あらすじ

In Fukuoka’s Kurume, there lives a shy female student voice actor named Yumeha Nitahara. With her timid nature, she rarely receives work offers. Just as she is about to give up, a new transfer student, the protagonist, suddenly appears before her.

“I’m Yumeha’s manager now!”

A relationship between a voice actor and her manager begins with a lie. Then, one day, a certain job opportunity comes Yumeha’s way. The two, still struggling to fully grow up, repeatedly drift apart and come closer together. And eventually, this leads to love.

あらすじ

A visual novel starring VTuber Minato Aqua.

Player plays the role of Aqua’s employer and falls in love with his maid. Set in a world that resembles western Europe.

The heroine is a new maid hiding a secret in service of the heir of the noble Francois family, who has lost his memories and has nightmares every night in which an unknown girl who says she hates him.
